message.content:
# Service Catalogue

## [Consultancy Name] — Data · Data Management · Automation · Artificial Intelligence

*Microsoft 365–centred, ecosystem-agnostic in ambition.*

---

## 1. About This Catalogue

We help organisations unlock the full value of their data, automate the work that shouldn't need humans, and deploy artificial intelligence where it genuinely moves the needle. Our primary operating environment is the Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and Azure stack — but we are not a single-vendor shop. We design for the tools that fit the problem, and we will tell you when the best answer lives outside the Microsoft estate.

Every engagement is grounded in three disciplines: **audit** (what you have), **roadmap** (where you're going), and **advisory** (how you get there safely, economically, and at a pace your people can absorb).

---

## 2. Practice Areas

The catalogue is organised into four practices. Within each, services are grouped by engagement type. Many organisations will engage across multiple practices in a single programme; others will take a single service.

---

### 2.1 DATA

*Understanding, structuring, and making your data an asset rather than a liability.*

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Data Maturity & Readiness Audit** | A structured assessment across your entire data landscape — not just M365. We inventory sources (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Dataverse, on-prem SQL, SaaS SaaS SaaS spreadsheets, legacy ERP/CRM), profile quality, map lineage, and score you against a maturity model (5-level: Ad hoc → Optimised). Output: a scored report with a 12-month remediation plan. |
| **Data Architecture & Modelling Advisory** | Design of canonical data models, master-data strategies, and reference architectures. We work within Fabric, Dataverse, and Azure Data Lake when those fit, but will equally design around Databricks, Snowflake, or a lean PostgreSQL estate if that is where your data actually lives. |
| **Data Quality & Stewardship Programme** | Ongoing governance: data ownership, profiling, cleansing pipelines, anomaly detection, and stewardship operating models. M365 Purview and Fabric Data Factory are common tooling, but the programme design is vendor-neutral. |
| **Data Migration & Integration Strategy** | Planning and execution of data movement between systems — M365-to-M365, M365-to-Azure, or cross-cloud. Includes schema mapping, ETL/ELT design, cutover planning, and data-validation sign-off. |
| **Data Security & Sovereignty Assessment** | Classification, sensitivity labelling (MIP/Purview), DLP policy review, residency and sovereignty checks, and access-pattern analysis. Critical for regulated industries (finance, public sector, health). Extends beyond M365 to cover any SaaS or on-prem data store in scope. |

---

### 2.2 DATA MANAGEMENT

*The operational discipline around data: governance, lifecycle, access, and accountability.*

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Information Governance Audit** | Full review of how data is created, stored, shared, retained, and destroyed across the organisation. We examine M365 retention policies, SharePoint/OneDrive access, Teams channel data, and any adjacent systems. Output: a gap analysis against your regulatory obligations (GDPR, DPA, sector-specific) and a prioritised remediation backlog. |
| **Records Management & Retention Roadmap** | Design and implementation of a compliant retention and disposition framework. Covers M365 retention labels, legal holds, and Purview Information Protection, plus non-Microsoft repositories. Includes a 3-year phased roadmap with clear ownership per data class. |
| **Data Governance Operating Model Design** | We design the *people and process* layer: roles (CDO, data stewards, data owners), decision rights, policy architecture, and governance cadence. Tooling (Purview, Collibra, Alation, or a lightweight SharePoint-based register) is chosen to fit the model, not the other way round. |
| **Access & Identity Governance Review** | Audit of user, group, M365 group, and application access across the tenant and connected systems. We identify over-provisioning, orphaned accounts, and shadow-access patterns and design a least-privilege operating model. Extends to Azure AD / Entra ID, SaaS connectors, and on-prem AD where relevant. |
| **Data Lifecycle & Disposition Advisory** | End-to-end lifecycle design: ingestion → active use → archival → destruction. We advise on tiering strategies (hot/warm/cold in Fabric, Azure Blob, or equivalent), automated disposition triggers, and the legal/contractual considerations for each stage. |

---

### 2.3 AUTOMATION

*Removing friction from repetitive work, from a single form to a cross-system workflow.*

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **Automation Opportunity Audit** | We walk your processes — with your people, in their actual work — and catalogue every manual, repetitive, or error-prone step. We score each by frequency, error rate, and business impact. Output: a ranked backlog of automation candidates with estimated effort and ROI. No vendor lock-in in the assessment; we map solutions across Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, n8n, Apache Airflow, or plain scripting depending on the use case. |
| **Workflow & Process Automation Design** | End-to-end design of automated flows: triggers, logic, integrations, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Typical M365 patterns (Power Automate + Teams + SharePoint + Dataverse) are our bread and butter, but we will route a flow through Azure Service Bus, a web service, or a third-party SaaS API when the process demands it. |
| **RPA & Intelligent Automation Strategy** | Advisory on where robotic process automation (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate Desktop) and AI-augmented automation add value versus where a simple API call or Power Automate cloud flow is cheaper and more maintainable. Includes a phased deployment roadmap and a build-vs-buy-vs-configure decision framework. |
| **Integration & API Strategy** | Assessment of your current integration landscape (point-to-point, ESB, iPaaS) and design of a target-state integration architecture. We work across M365 connectors, Azure API Management, Logic Apps, and third-party iPaaS platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato) to design a pragmatic, maintainable integration layer. |
| **Automation Governance & Operations** | Design of the operating model for automation at scale: monitoring, alerting, change management, version control, ownership, and decommissioning. We help you avoid the "automation swamp" where 200 unmanaged flows become a liability. Includes a runbook and SLA framework for your automation estate. |

---

### 2.4 ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE

*Pragmatic, responsible AI — from first Copilot pilot to production agentic systems.*

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **AI Readiness & Opportunity Assessment** | A structured audit of where AI can create genuine value in your organisation. We assess data readiness, process suitability, skill availability, and risk appetite. We map opportunities across the full spectrum: M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform AI Builder, Azure AI Foundry, open-source LLMs, and specialist models. Output: a scored opportunity map with a 12/24-month phased plan. |
| **Copilot & Copilot Studio Implementation** | Hands-on deployment and tuning of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, and custom copilots within the M365 tenant. Includes prompt engineering, data-connector configuration, DLP-aware deployment, user adoption planning, and a post-launch optimisation cycle. |
| **Generative AI & LLM Strategy (Vendor-Neutral)** | Advisory on the full landscape of generative AI: Microsoft (Azure OpenAI, Fabric AI, Copilot), open-weight models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen), and hosted alternatives (AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex). We help you build a decision framework for which model, where, and under what data-governance and security constraints. |
| **Agentic AI Design & Pilot** | Design and pilot of autonomous or semi-autonomous AI agents: multi-step reasoning, tool-use, memory, and orchestration. We work with Copilot Studio, AutoGen, LangGraph, CrewAI, and Azure AI Agent Service to design agents that fit your process reality. Includes safety guardrails, human-override patterns, and evaluation frameworks. |
| **AI Governance, Ethics & Risk Framework** | Design of your organisational AI governance: model inventory, bias and fairness testing, explainability requirements, data-provenance checks, incident response, and regulatory alignment (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, sector-specific guidance). We build the framework, the policies, and the operating rhythm — not just the tech. |
| **AI-Enabled Data & Analytics (Fabric / Beyond)** | Advisory and implementation of AI within your analytics stack: natural-language querying (Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot), predictive and anomaly-detection models, computer-vision use cases, and LLM-augmented reporting. We design for the platform that fits — Fabric, Azure ML, Databricks, or a leaner setup. |
| **AI Skills & Organisational Readiness** | Training, upskilling, and change-management programmes for your teams. From "Copilot in 90 minutes" workshops for end-users to architectural deep-dives for your engineers and AI-governance training for leadership. We tailor content to the specific tools and use cases in your roadmap. |

---

## 3. Cross-Cutting Engagement Types

These are not separate practices; they are the *lenses* we apply across all four practices above.

### 3.1 Audits & Assessments
A fixed-scope, time-boxed diagnostic. We arrive with a methodology, you arrive with your systems and your people. We leave with a scored report, a risk register, a prioritised backlog, and a clear statement of what it will cost and take to close the gaps. Typical duration: 2–6 weeks.

### 3.2 Roadmaps & Strategy
A 12-to-36-month phased plan derived from audit findings, your business objectives, and your budget reality. We sequence initiatives by dependency, risk, and value. We model build-vs-buy-vs-partner for each initiative. We define the operating model (who owns what, what cadence, what KPIs). We do not just hand you a slide deck; we work with your leadership to pressure-test it.

### 3.3 Advisory & Fractional Leadership
Ongoing, part-time or part-quarter senior expertise embedded in your team. Think: a fractional Data Architect, a fractional AI Lead, a fractional Automation Practice Manager. We plug into your delivery, your governance, and your vendor-management rhythms. This is the service for organisations that need senior judgment without the full-time cost.

### 3.4 Implementation & Build
Hands-on delivery. When the roadmap says "build it," we build it. This is where we get into Power Platform, Fabric, Azure, and the broader toolset. We follow a structured delivery model: discovery → design → build → test → deploy → stabilise → optimise. Every build includes documentation, a handover pack, and a 90-day hypercare window.

### 3.5 Training, Enablement & Change
From one-off workshops to multi-month upskilling programmes. We train end-users, power users, developers, and executives. Content is specific to *your* tools, *your* use cases, and *your* data — not generic "Intro to AI" slides.

---

## 4. Technology Scope

Our primary working environment is the **Microsoft 365 / Power Platform / Azure** stack:

> M365 Copilot · Copilot Studio · Power Automate · Power Apps · Power BI · Fabric · Dataverse · Purview · SharePoint · Teams · OneDrive · Entra ID · Azure AI Foundry · Azure OpenAI Service · Azure Data Lake / Synapse · Azure DevOps

But we are **not** a Microsoft-only shop. We work across and alongside:

> **Data & Analytics:** Databricks · Snowflake · PostgreSQL · dbt · Apache Spark · Alteryx
> **AI / ML:** Azure ML · AWS Bedrock · GCP Vertex · Hugging Face · LangChain / LangGraph · AutoGen · CrewAI · Ollama
> **Automation & Integration:** n8n · Apache Airflow · MuleSoft · Boomi · Workato · Miro / Power Automate
> **Governance & Metadata:** Collibra · Alation · Apache Atlas · Purview
> **RPA:** UiPath · Automation Anywhere · Power Automate Desktop
> **Observability & Ops:** Azure Monitor · Datadog · Grafana · OpenTelemetry

If the best tool for the job is not a Microsoft product, we will tell you, explain why, and help you integrate it cleanly into your M365-centric estate.

---

## 5. Delivery Models

| Model | Best For | Typical Duration |
|---|---|---|
| **Sprint** | A single, well-defined service (e.g., a data audit, a Copilot pilot, a retention roadmap) | 2 – 8 weeks |
| **Programme** | Multi-workstream transformation (e.g., full data-governance overhaul + automation estate + AI pilot) | 6 – 18 months |
| **Embedded / Fractional** | Ongoing senior expertise on a part-time or part-quarter basis | 3 – 24 months, rolling |
| **Retainer / Advisory** | Standing advisory, governance cadence, and on-call expertise | Monthly or quarterly |

All engagements include a named lead consultant, a clear communication cadence, and a shared working space (M365 Teams / SharePoint by default, or your preferred tool).

---

## 6. How to Start

1. **Discovery Call (60 min, no cost).** You tell us what's keeping you up at night. We tell you honestly whether we can help and what shape the engagement would take.
2. **Scope & Proposal (1–2 weeks).** We define the audit or advisory scope, the team, the timeline, and the fixed fee.
3. **Engagement.** We work. You see progress in your own M365 tenant, your own boards, your own language.
4. **Handover & Optimisation.** We leave you with documentation, trained people, a governed operating model, and a 90-day optimisation window. Then we step back — or stay, if you want us to.

---

*This catalogue is a living document. As the M365, Power Platform, and AI landscapes evolve — and they do, quarterly — so does ours. The principles (audit before you build, govern before you scale, automate before you add headcount, deploy AI where it earns its place) do not.*

---
